name: Invitation Maker
subtitle: Birthday & party card design
promotional_text: Turn a template into an invitation with your names, time and venue. Style the text, preview the finished card, then share the image or save it to Photos.
description:
Make a birthday or party invitation with the details your guests need. Start with an illustrated template, add your own words and turn the card into an invitation image to share.

Choose a design
Browse occasion templates and view a full sample card in Template Details. Use the artwork and lettering as a starting point for your event.

Make the invitation yours
Add the event title, name, date, time, venue and address. Edit individual text blocks and choose fonts for the title and message. See your words on the card as you personalize it.

Preview, share and save
Look over the complete invitation and read your event details before sharing. Open Share Invitation to share the invitation image, or use Save to Photos to keep a copy in your photo library.
whats_new: This version includes invitation templates, event details, text and font editing, and options to share invitations or save them to Photos.
